svg.title: MX frame roadmap: the path to omxcore
svg.desc: Vision: DuckDB-class SQL that uses your GPU and links into any app with no Python. Plug and play with the CSV and Parquet files you already have. What omxcore can be: A faster drop-in for DuckDB; GPU-native analytics on one machine; An embedded engine for apps; The data engine for AI agents; The compute half of a lakehouse; Live dataframes for simulation; ML data prep. The path: 1. SQL and joins, then the TPC-H 22 gate (we are here); 2. Quiet-machine scoreboard; 3. Close the gaps; 4. omxcore 0.7.0; 5. Agent-native plugins; 6. Bigger than RAM, the long tail. Built for agents (plugins on the core · planned · m10, after 0.7.0): Plug and play: point it at your CSV and Parquet files. mx (today): speaks JSON, starts in 12 ms, no Python; Vector search, GPU-native (planned): embeddings beside your data; nearest-k with SQL filters in one query; Agent search (planned): keyword + vector + SQL in one ranked call, with why each row matched; Classification and decision API (planned): label or route rows, batched on the GPU; MCP server (with 0.7.0): every agent gets sql / explain / schema / search as tools; Agent memory (planned): facts with time and source, queried like any table.
